# Study: the rulebook tables (restructure step 3; the user: "Yes, start the rulebook", 2026-10-23)

**Goal:** one directory of tables generated by script from the server source and data files, regenerated when the server
changes, read by the Pilot's policies (itemvalue.py, danger rules, wield/wear, escape) and queried by the Navigator.
Home: `Advisor/data/rulebook/` (build script, CSVs, README with schema and source lines, a query CLI). The Architect
copies or links them into the Pilot.

Consumers known now: itemvalue.py placeholders UNKNOWN_FLAVOUR (by tval only) and PSEUDO_BONUS (by feeling only); the
danger table (levels <= 40; Dive04 is clvl 22 at 650-700 ft); set-pieces A1 (mob, stairs far), A6 (summoners), C8 (ability
inference), B6 (traps); wield/wear policy (blows x damage, brands).

| table | source | who | status |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 kinds + unknown-flavour expectations per kind by level (so the Pilot can renormalise over still-unaware kinds) | object.txt, get_obj_num, charges | Advisor (dist.py, kinds.py; CHR fix) | done |
| T2 pseudo-ID / apply_magic expectations: {good}/{excellent}/{special}/{average} by tval and level: plusses, ego distribution, value | object2.c apply_magic, ego_item.txt | K1 formulas -> Advisor sim | done |
| T3 monster danger, levels 0-70: melee by AC, spells/breaths damage, summons, drains, paralysis, speed, HP, exp, flags | monster.txt, melee1/2.c, spells | K2 formulas -> Advisor script (extend build_danger_table.py) | done |
| T4 character model: exp, HP, blows table, to-hit/damage, device skill, saves, stealth (from progression) | tables.c, p_*.txt | Advisor (progression study CSVs) | done |
| T5 timing + odds: level_speed, energy, time bubbles, recall turns/seconds, restock, light/food burn; traps, search, disarm, chests, device fail, recharge, enchant | dungeon.c, xtra2.c, cmd1/2.c, spells2.c | K3 -> Advisor | done |
| T6 shops: owners (A/S at any CHR), store stock tables, restock | store.c, init2.c, shop_own.txt | Advisor (shops study + CHR formula) | done |
| T7 structures: room types and geometry, vault list | generate.c, vault.txt | Advisor (mission15 study CSVs) | done |

## Result (2026-10-24)
Memo `../memos/2026-10-24-rulebook.md` + note. Tables in `data/rulebook/`. Verified: GF_BOULDER absent from project_p
(spells1.c:3540-4092 case list), CONSTANT_TIME_FACTOR 5 and the bubble code (xtra2.c:5180-5207), the Pilot's --hpwarn 0
(pilot.py:5135-5141). Brodda melee model vs the m15 log (consistent). Retrospective: "formulas by Clerk, tables by
script" worked well — no Clerk arithmetic in the tables. Monte Carlo build_feelings.py is slow (~5 min at 3000 samples).
